title: Ruth Paine and Marina find the Walker note after the FBI search
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Ruth Paine and Marina find the Walker note after the FBI search, about 1963-1964 at Texas (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the assassination, after the FBI's already searched the home extensively, Ruth Payne comes and says, "Oh, me and Marina found this other uh note that he left for Marina.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, talks about the events after President John F. Kennedy was shot in 1963. He says that after the FBI had already searched the home thoroughly, a woman named Ruth Paine came forward saying that she and Marina Oswald, wife of the accused gunman Lee Harvey Oswald, had found another note he left for Marina, the one linked to a man named Edwin Walker. Sheehan tells it because a note turning up after a careful search would raise questions about how the evidence appeared.
